findings.title: Keep the household-count sense historical without present-use evidence
findings.details: The revised article marks the household-count sense historical and removes the prior unsupported current classification. Its cited evidence documents historical-text uses, while the dossier reports no evidence establishing present use. Preserve that status unless current-use evidence is added.
findings.verification: Check that future article revisions and generated has_sense edges keep this sense historical unless cited evidence establishes present-day use.

findings.title: Keep the chronology of 口’s extended senses unresolved
findings.details: The article appropriately says the evidence does not date the beginnings of the opening and household-count uses or establish a semantic path from the mouth sense. Keep these limits explicit; historical examples and current definitions do not establish a chronological chain.
findings.verification: Check that revisions do not claim a dated origin or semantic development among these senses without evidence establishing it.

findings.title: Do not present indexed oracle-bone examples as the first attestation
findings.details: The dossier says the exact first attestation of 口 is not established; the indexed oracle-bone examples are not verified as the earliest occurrence. The article preserves this qualification and uses dating unresolved for the mouth sense.
findings.verification: Check any future earliest-attested claim against evidence that establishes priority, rather than relying on indexed examples alone.

findings.title: Retain the unverified 字源 graphic-history proposal as a research gap

findings.verification: Inspect the cited page and independently verify the proposed graphic history against source inscriptions before presenting it as established.
